title: Single cycle actuator handshakes with one transition per scan
requirements:
# SELF011: Sequential Gripper-Transfer Handshake Cycle

## Background
Five-stage pick/clamp/release/retract handshake sequence (`IDLE`, `EXTEND`, `CLAMP`, `RELEASE`, `RETRACT`, `DONE`).

## Functional Requirements
1. Inputs: `Start`, `Stop`, `Reset`, `ExtendDone`, `ClampDone`, `ReleaseDone`, `RetractDone` (`BOOL`).
2. If `Stop = TRUE` or `Reset = TRUE`, return immediately to `IDLE` and clear all outputs.
3. Otherwise from `IDLE`: enter `EXTEND` iff `Start = TRUE AND RetractDone = TRUE`.
4. Advance one step per scan on matching feedback: `EXTEND & ExtendDone -> CLAMP`; `CLAMP & ClampDone -> RELEASE`; `RELEASE & ReleaseDone -> RETRACT`; `RETRACT & RetractDone -> DONE`; `DONE` holds until `Stop`/`Reset`.
5. Outputs match post-transition phase: `Extend`/`Clamp`/`Release`/`Retract` mirror their named state, `Busy` holds in active steps `1..4`, `Done` holds in `DONE`.

## Interface
- **Inputs:** `Start: BOOL`, `Stop: BOOL`, `Reset: BOOL`, `ExtendDone: BOOL`, `ClampDone: BOOL`, `ReleaseDone: BOOL`, `RetractDone: BOOL`
- **Outputs:** `Extend: BOOL`, `Clamp: BOOL`, `Release: BOOL`, `Retract: BOOL`, `Busy: BOOL`, `Done: BOOL`

## Initial Values
- `state="IDLE"`, `all_commands=false`, `Extend=false`, `Clamp=false`, `Release=false`, `Retract=false`, `Busy=false`, `Done=false`

## Timing & Evaluation Conventions
At most one transition occurs per scan; all inputs are level-sensitive.
scenario: An assembly fixture coordinates an extending slide and a clamp using explicit completion handshakes, allowing deterministic commissioning tests.
scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: Stop or Reset overrides all transitions
At most one state transition per invocation
assumptions: Completion inputs are handshake states; no mechanical safety certification is implied.
No timeout is included; an absent handshake intentionally stalls the current action.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.

atomic_propositions.Clamp: O[k].Clamp: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Release: O[k].Release: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.Retract: O[k].Retract: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.

atomic_propositions.first: k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.mode=IDLE, O_init.Extend=false, O_init.Clamp=false, O_init.Release=false, O_init.Retract=false, O_init.Busy=false, O_init.Done=false.

ltl.description: Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.
ltl.explanation: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Home-qualified Start enters only the first action.
A completed cycle cannot restart without an explicit clear.
The fixture waits for an extension handshake rather than assuming completion.

ltl.description: Busy holds iff one of the four active stages (Extend/Clamp/Release/Retract) is active, and is mutually exclusive with Done.
ltl.explanation: Previously Busy had no positive constraint during active stages.

ltl.formula: G(((normal & qIdle & !(Start & RetractDone)) -> (!Busy & !Done)) & ((normal & qClamp & !ClampDone) -> Clamp) & ((normal & qRelease & !ReleaseDone) -> Release) & ((normal & qRetract & !RetractDone) -> Retract))
ltl.description: IDLE without Start & RetractDone stays all-off, and CLAMP/RELEASE/RETRACT hold their actuator while awaiting completion feedback.
ltl.explanation: Completes stage-hold symmetry alongside existing P9 (EXTEND hold).
